description:
Replace the GenServer with a struct + pure functions:

- `StdinFSM.new(opts)` → `%StdinFSM{}` (fields: `buffer`, `flush_ms`)
- `StdinFSM.process(state, bin)` → `{state, events, next_timeout_ms | :infinity}`
- `StdinFSM.flush(state)` → `{state, events}`
- `StdinFSM.clear(state)` → `state`

No `subscriber` field — emission is the caller's job. No `GenServer.call`, no `handle_info`, no timeout handling inside the module.

Port the existing stdin_fsm_test.exs to the functional API. Tests should drive the FSM directly and assert on returned `{state, events, next_timeout}` triples instead of `assert_receive`.
title: Refactor StdinFSM to a pure functional module
